subject: general
question: Which among the following is NOT a bacterial disease?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabies.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rabies is a** viral disease.** It is caused by the** rabies virus, **which belongs to the family** Rhabdoviridae, genus Lyssavirus. **This virus primarily infects mammals, including humans, and it is typically transmitted through the saliva of infected animals, often through bites or scratches. Once symptoms develop, rabies is almost always fatal if left untreated.
 
• **Cholera** is a bacterial disease caused by the **bacterium Vibrio cholerae** and is transmitted through **contaminated water and food.**
 
• **Typhoid** is also a bacterial disease caused by the bacterium Salmonella typhi and is transmitted through **contaminated water and food.**
 
• **Plague is a bacterial disease** caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis and is transmitted through **fleas that infest rodents.**
 
• ***Therefore, the correct answer is option 3, Rabies, as it is a viral disease and not caused by bacteria.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cholera: **Symptoms include diarrhea, vomiting, and dehydration. It can be prevented through proper sanitation and hygiene practices.
 
• **Typhoid:** Symptoms include high fever, weakness, and stomach pain. It can be prevented through vaccination and proper sanitation and hygiene practices.
 
• **Plague:** Symptoms include fever, chills, and swollen lymph nodes. It can be prevented through rodent control and flea control measures.
